articles.title: You Can Get a 36V 350W Adult Electric Scooter With 19mph Top Speed for Less Than $80 for Black Friday
articles.summary: There are many reasons why an electric scooter might be a better fit for you than an electric bike. They're lighter, more compact, and usually less expensive. Electric assisted scooters give you more range and speed for less effort, and the brushless motor is pretty quiet.
body: AliExpress is offering the very popular LADPED LP60 350W electric scooter with 36V 5.2Ah battery for a mere $79.10 with free shipping after coupon code " DBDEAL20 ". AliExpress marketplace vendor AOVOPRO is the official manufacturer of these scooters and has plenty of reviews and sales to back up its reputation. Since the item already been shipped from overseas, any tariffs have already been paid for and you also don't need to worry about egregiously long shipping times.

If you're waiting for Prime Day for a better deal, don't bother. Amazon has never offered an electric scooter like this for under $100. For those kinds of deals, AliExpress is usually the best place to look.

The LADPED electric scooter is a solid entry level options for adults. The LP60 is equipped with a peppy 350W brushless motor that can push the scooter at speeds of up to 19mph. LADPED claims up to 16 miles on the 36V 5.2Ah battery, but expect real world range to be closer to 10-12 miles under typical conditions. The LP60 weighs about 34 pounds and can be folded for easier transport and storage. It's equipped with 8.5" maintenance-free tires for paved surfaces.
points: There are many reasons why an electric scooter might be a better fit for you than an electric bike.
They're lighter, more compact, and usually less expensive.
Electric assisted scooters give you more range and speed for less effort, and the brushless motor is pretty quiet.

articles.title: I Just Found an Actual Deal on Corsair DDR5 Desktop Memory Ahead of Black Friday
articles.summary: RAM is expensive and there's no way of getting around it. If you're going to upgrade your existing memory or build a PC from scratch, you just have to accept the fact that your budget needs to accommodate for today's RAM prices. Still not fazed?
body: For a limited time, you can pick up 16GB (2x8GB) of Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5-5200MHz Desktop Memory for $208.81 with free shipping after you apply $50 off coupon code " USAFF50 ". You'll need to be signed into your AliExpress account. If the page says it's not available for shipping, reload a couple of times (sometimes it's actually out of stock, sometimes it's just a glitch). If you buy it directly from Newegg's site, you're going to pay $310 for the same RAM.

Corsair is a very well known - if not the most well known - memory brand. This particular kit includes 2 sticks of DDR5-5200MHz PC5-41600 RAM with timings of 40-40-40-77. It's specifically designed for AMD builds and features an EXPO certified memory profile. This isn't exactly blazing fast RAM, but unless you're doing some hardcore overclocking, you probably won't notice any difference in performance compared to RAM with tighter timings. For some extra pizazz, these sticks also feature Corsair's slick RGB heatspreaders.

articles.title: WoW: Forever’s First New Legendary Weapon Revealed
articles.summary: Update: Blizzard has officially revealed it is, in fact, a new legendary weapon: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood. Weta Workshop crafted a full-scale replica of the weapon in a video posted to the Warcraft Twitch stream. Original article is below.
body: World of Warcraft: Forever's launch is imminent, and Blizzard used the occasion to tease what looks to be the game's first new legendary weapon.

Earlier today, a stream went live on the Warcraft Twitch channel that shows the creation of what looks to be a full-scale night-elf-themed staff weapon. The name of the stream is titled Camelot_revealv2_final.mp4, with Camelot being a reference to Forever's development codename. Twitch itself is hyping up the stream, stating in a blog it will lead to a "major reveal and a particularly exciting moment you don't want to miss."

The builders on stream can be seen using 3D printers and all other kinds of tools to craft what looks like a life-size replica of a specific staff that has been popping up in recent Forever promotional materials. A staff wielded by a skyborne Druid that looks extremely similar to the one being built can be seen in the recent Warpath animated music video. New promotional Forever artwork on Battle.net also looks to feature the same, distinct staff, once again wielding by a skyborne Druid.
points: Update: Blizzard has officially revealed it is, in fact, a new legendary weapon: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood.

articles.title: Pokémon: The Series DVDs Are Getting Early Black Friday Price Drops at Amazon
articles.summary: Amazon just launched a new sale on a ton of Pokémon DVDs. If you've been looking to add some physical discs to your collection, right now is a pretty good time to do so before most Black Friday sales actually start.
body: If you were hoping for a collection of Blu-rays here, the bad news is that those don't even exist for some of the earlier seasons. The later seasons have received Blu-ray releases of course, but those don't appear to be on sale just yet. The only good Pokémon Blu-ray deal right now is actually a remaster of the first season.

The Blu-ray edition of this season is definitely the way to go if you're looking for the highest possible quality. DVDs can only get you 480p resolution, so the animation looks much sharper with the upgrade. That being said, the Blu-ray edition only contains the first 52 episodes of the Indigo League arc compared to the full 78 episodes you get with the DVD.

For those who are holding out for the Blu-rays, it's worth noting that there is a 24-movie Blu-ray collection that comes in a Pokéball you can preorder right now. It's $400 of course, but it doubles as an awesome display item for any shelf. It's set to release on December 22, 2026.

articles.title: Leonardo DiCaprio and Joaquin Phoenix Were Offered the Role of the Joker in The Dark Knight, But Turned it Down
articles.summary: When speaking at the Nashville Film Festival (via TV Intelligentsia and Batman News ), Christopher Nolan's longtime casting director John Papsidera revealed that Heath Ledger was not the first choice for Joker in The Dark Knight.
body: Leonardo DiCaprio and Joaquin Phoenix were both offered the role of Joker in The Dark Knight, but ended up turning it down, according to the film's casting director.

Eventually, they landed on Heath Ledger, and the rest is history. Leonardo DiCaprio went on to star in Nolan's next project, Inception. The actor also stated last year that The Dark Knight was his favorite Nolan film. Warner Bros. reportedly pressured Nolan and his creative team to cast the Titanic star as The Riddler in the third Batman movie. The team went against this idea, since they typically developed the story for Batman first and then tried to figure out a villain. As a result, Bane made for a more logical villain in a story about an aging Batman who is physically outmatched.

And as already noted, Phoenix went on to play a completely different version of the Joker. In his two films, Joker is far less calculated. He's more of a guy who stumbles into becoming a symbol for chaos, revolution, and anarchy, though is wildly out of his depth.

articles.title: WoW: Forever May Have Just Sneakily Revealed New Class And Race Combos
articles.summary: Developer Blizzard may have just revealed new World of Warcraft: Forever class and race combos less than a day before the game's launch. Forever already features a number of new class and race combos not seen in WoW Classic, like troll Warlocks, human Hunters, and more.
body: Along what appeared to be various class abilities that aren't currently in the game, certain class and race combinations that aren't currently possible can also be seen. A total of three new race and class combos are shown in the footage, including a tauren Mage casting frostbolt, a skyborne Paladin, and what appears to be a night elf Shaman (or at least a night elf wearing a Shaman armor set).

Those would each be big additions, particularly when it comes to more options for Paladin and Shaman players. Currently in Forever, only dwarves can be Shamans on the Alliance side of the MMO's faction divide, while the only Paladin option on Horde is undead. Having additional choices is never a bad thing, and a second Shaman option would likely be well received by the game's community.

Since skyborne can be either faction, this would give Horde players another race choice for Paladin, but could also ruffle some feathers. Skyborne are currently locked behind a $30 paywall, and some players might not take kindly to having a new paladin option cost additional cash.
points: Developer Blizzard may have just revealed new World of Warcraft: Forever class and race combos less than a day before the game's launch.

articles.title: GTA 6 Will Now Come To Stores Sooner, But It’s Not Playable Right Away
articles.summary: Rockstar Games has announced that Grand Theft Auto 6 will now released in stores two days earlier than anticipated--but this doesn't change anything about when you'll actually be able to play the game.
body: GTA 6's code-in-a-box physical edition will be available to purchase in stores starting on November 10; it was previously going to be November 12.

Rockstar also moved up the preloading date for GTA 6 from November 12 to November 10 for the digital and code-in-a-box versions. The developer offered no explanation as to why it made these changes, and the company did not respond to GameSpot's request seeking comment.

While you might walk into a Target or Best Buy or GameStop on November 10 and see a copy of GTA 6 that you can spend real money on, you cannot actually play the game until November 19 when the game goes live. If you're in the US, you'll be among the last people in the world to get in due to how the game is launching non-simultaneously.

Also in the post, Rockstar confirmed what everyone expected: The $100 Ultimate Edition of GTA 6 is not going to be sold in stores. This move, along with ditching discs entirely, is all about making money.

articles.title: Escape From Tarkov Creator Reveals New Hardcore Sci-Fi Shooter
articles.summary: Fans of hardcore tactical shooters have a new game to keep an eye on, particularly if they've spent hundreds of hours navigating the brutal world of Escape from Tarkov.
body: Called Fragmentary Order, the upcoming sci-fi tactical shooter just received its first gameplay reveal, featuring 14 minutes of in-engine footage. Set across the Solar System in 2251, the game imagines a future where warfare has become an outsourced business, with players controlling remotely operated clones rather than putting their own lives on the line.

In Fragmentary Order, players control remotely operated clones known as RepEnts, which are deployed across large combat zones to carry out dangerous missions. Losing one of these clones isn't necessarily the end of the road. In this world, death is simply another business expense, although that doesn't mean players can afford to be careless.

The game features large-scale environments, changing environmental conditions, vehicles, drones, and advanced technological systems. Players will also be able to team up in squads of up to four, with careful coordination and planning playing a major role in surviving encounters.
points: Fans of hardcore tactical shooters have a new game to keep an eye on, particularly if they've spent hundreds of hours navigating the brutal world of Escape from Tarkov.

articles.title: GTA 6 Is A Massive Download, But You May Qualify For A Free Speed Boost To Download It Faster
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and the game's file size, 212GB, is truly massive. One internet company, Spectrum, is turning this into a marketing moment for its own services by offering members a "free Gig Speed Lift" in November to help download the game faster.
body: Available November 9-30, the offer has "no cost and no strings attached," the company said. The offer is fairly straightforward: Customers with a qualifying internet plan and compatible equipment can use the My Spectrum app to opt in. Then on November 9, customers will have their download speeds upped to 1Gbps. If you're already on a plan offering that, you'll get boosted to 2Gbps.
Spectrum said the boost should allow people to download GTA 6 in under 30 minutes.

The free upgrade offer runs through November 30, so that also covers Thanksgiving, when you might have a bunch of people in your home and want faster internet. It also covers the Black Friday and Cyber Monday shopping holidays.

After November 30, the speed boost gets pulled from your account with no further action required on your part. The whole idea here is that Spectrum thinks you'll enjoy it so much that you'll pay to upgrade on a more permanent basis.
points: Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and the game's file size, 212GB, is truly massive.

articles.title: Best Buy's Midnight 'Zelda' Switch 2 Console Release Is Already Intense
articles.summary: Ever since Nintendo announced the official release of a Switch 2 console for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, trying to get one has been a bloodbath. Even with constant restocks, the Triforce-themed hardware keeps selling out within seconds.
body: Best Buy is holding a midnight launch for the upcoming Zelda game and its associated Nintendo Switch 2 system and Pro Controller tonight, on Nov. 4. Fans who already preordered but want to get in on the fun can have their goods shipped to a local store for pickup during the midnight launch. Fans who haven't yet secured the foil cover edition or its hardware accessories have good reason to show up as well. The Best Buy website says that a limited number of consoles and Zelda controllers will be available for purchase in store.

Fans have taken that warning to heart, it seems. Social media pictures of stores across the United States show that people are lining up hours, if not days, in anticipation of the new Nintendo console. Some onlookers have assumed the lines must be for Pokémon cards releasing on Friday, or for Black Friday deals. Most likely, the lines are for the hot products that are imminently releasing, not ones that are days away. In some cases, Best Buy locations have two lines: one for pre-orders, and one for people who don't have one.

articles.title: Magic: The Gathering Casts Stranger Things Star as Female Lead
articles.summary: Legendary Entertainment and Hasbro's live-action Magic: The Gathering movie is one step closer to reality. According to two new reports, Stranger Things and Inside Out 2 star Maya Hawke has been cast in a lead role in director Matt Johnson's adaptation of the 33-year-old trading card game.
body: Deadline and independent reporter Daniel Richtmann broke Hawke's casting in Magic: The Gathering on Wednesday, marking the first cast member to be attached to the project. Matt Johnson, the director of Blackberry, Tony, and Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie, is helming the adaptation and writing the script with Noah Gardner and Aidan Fitzgerald.

Hawke is best known for her roles as Robin Buckley in Netflix's Stranger Things, Anxiety in Pixar's Inside Out 2, and June Douglas/Lucretia Shaver in Wes Anderson's Asteroid City. (She's also pretty well known for being the daughter of Uma Thurman and Ethan Hawke.) Hawke will next appear in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping as Wiress.

Johnson is an avowed and longtime Magic: The Gathering fan. He said in an interview with The Big Picture podcast earlier this year that his childhood dream "was to be a professional Magic card player," but that he gave up that dream after competing in a pro tour against player Richard Hoaen, "who just beat the shit out of me," Johnson said.
points: Legendary Entertainment and Hasbro's live-action Magic: The Gathering movie is one step closer to reality.

articles.title: Arkane union says closing the studio "would probably be more expensive" for Xbox than simply finishing Marvel's Blade
articles.summary: Xbox would probably spend more money shutting down Arkane Lyon than it would trying to finish and release Marvel's Blade, according to a union representing workers from the beloved imsim studio.
body: In a statement posted to the STJV (Syndicat des travailleureuses du jeu vidéo) website, the French union claimed that development on Marvel's Blade is "going fine" and is shaping up to be on par with Arkane's widely acclaimed gameography. By choosing to part ways with and potentially close the famed studio, the union says Microsoft is "sabotaging the game it funded."

After Xbox's sweeping job cuts and divestments from several first-party studios, Arkane was recently given until December to find a new buyer and ensure its future. Ubisoft Entertainment (Assassin's Creed, Rainbow Six) is reportedly one of the companies interested in buying the studio behind Dishonored, Prey and the upcoming superhero adaptation, though nothing has been finalised yet.

The union also blamed many of the studio's problems on Microsoft - a hiring freeze that lasted more than a year supposedly inflated the game's budget and caused additional internal delays. "Microsoft now use those same delay and additional costs as a reason to close the studio," the statement said.
points: Xbox would probably spend more money shutting down Arkane Lyon than it would trying to finish and release Marvel's Blade, according to a union representing workers from the beloved imsim studio.

articles.title: New D&D Book Introduces Some of the Most Terrifying Boss Fights in the Game’s History
articles.summary: Vecna is arguably the archetypical "boss character" in Dungeons & Dragons. For almost 40 years now, Vecna's machinations have endangered D&D's multiverse, only to be opposed and defeated but never permanently destroyed by groups of outmatched adventurers.
body: One thing that isn't really up for debate, however, is that Wizards' writing team made WoW 's signature characters into forces to be reckoned with. Only a relative handful of Warcraft 's big names got stat blocks in the D&D crossover, but all of them have been designed as major threats in ways that mark a departure from D&D 's past design choices.

D&D 's World of Warcraft book is set roughly around the time of WoW 's 10th expansion, The War Within, with a few nods towards the current expansion Midnight. If you haven't kept up with the story of WoW ’s modern servers for a few years, there's a lot in D&D: WoW that may come as a mild shock.

This book only provides stats for the relative handful of major NPCs who are currently center stage, namely Alleria, Anduin, Jaina, and Thrall, as well as fan favorites Illidan and Sylvanas. Arthas snuck in due to being the primary antagonist of the Icecrown Citadel map pack, despite being one of the most thoroughly dead characters in WoW as of Shadowlands.

articles.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Navi actor reprises her role after 28 years, but it was a total accident due to Nintendo's blind auditions
articles.summary: For The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 's shiny new remake, Nintendo unintentionally cast the same actor twice - 28 years apart - to deliver Navi's infamous "Heys!" and "Listens!"
body: The Switch 2 's Ocarina of Time makes a pretty substantial change to the N64's Ocarina of Time, released almost three decades prior. There's proper voice acting this time, of course - not just grunts and murmurs and hyahs. But even when retroactively adding new things, Nintendo wanted to ensure the remake's cast matched the original's pretty faithfully, so the developer held blind auditions that eventually paved the way for one actor to reprise their role during Link's adventure.

"We felt that if we were going to improve the graphics so dramatically, the cutscenes needed to be fully voiced to match," director HokWai Ng explained in the most recent Ask The Developer blog. "But at the same time, we knew we shouldn't mess with established perceptions of how certain characters sound based on the original. Navi's "Listen!" is one example. Even someone who's never played The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time may have heard it before. We absolutely didn't want to change anything as iconic as that."
To maintain the original's nostalgic sounds and voices, Nintendo held blind auditions with the goal of finding actors who could recreate the "feel of the original game."
points: For The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 's shiny new remake, Nintendo unintentionally cast the same actor twice - 28 years apart - to deliver Navi's infamous "Heys!" and "Listens!"

articles.title: God of War Laufey delayed three months to May 2027, as Sony Santa Monica escapes a packed February
articles.summary: God of War Laufey has been delayed. Sony Santa Monica's PS5 exclusive is now dodging the crowded month of February and will instead come out on 20th May, 2027.
body: Developer Sony Santa Monica announced it's pushing back the upcoming action epic via a brief social media post. While the studio stopped short of giving a reason for the delay, it did say it's using the extra time to polish Faye's solo adventure.

"Since the reveal of God of War Laufey in June, we've been deeply grateful to see so much excitement for Faye's journey through the Everywhen. We don't take for granted the trust placed in the studio to make an extraordinary experience worthy of the passion and dedication of our fans," the studio wrote.

"With this in mind, we've made the decision to delay God of War Laufey's release to May 20th, 2027," the statement continued. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential. On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon."
points: Sony Santa Monica's PS5 exclusive is now dodging the crowded month of February and will instead come out on 20th May, 2027.

videos.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Review
videos.summary: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time reviewed by Logan Plant on Nintendo Switch 2.
body: "It’s in our nature to pass old stories down, and I think there’s meaning in the ones we choose to revisit. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is both an exceptional remake of an incredible game and a rich adventure that stands on its own. This remake proves there’s still so much value in the traditional Zelda formula: the dense, intimate world of Hyrule is stuffed with charming characters and fascinating secrets. Its intricate dungeons are satisfying to unravel, even if their somewhat streamlined design has slightly dulled the special feeling that comes from solving them. Still, the depth, quality, and attention to detail in every corner match the lofty reputation of this series. Whether you’ve played the original 100 times, once back in 1998, or never at all, I highly recommend this beautiful retelling of a legend."
points: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time reviewed by Logan Plant on Nintendo Switch 2.

videos.title: Lords of War - Official Teaser Trailer (2027) Nicholas Cage, Bill Skarsgård, Laura Harrier
videos.summary: Check out the teaser trailer for Lords of War, an upcoming movie starring Nicolas Cage, Bill Skarsgård, Laura Harrier, Sylvia Hoeks, and Greg Tarzan Davis.
body: Academy Award winner Nicolas Cage reprises his role as Yuri Orlov, the world’s most notorious arms dealer. When Yuri discovers a ruthless mercenary mastermind (Bill Skarsgård) bent on destroying his legacy is building a private army, he is thrust into a blood-soaked and bullet-riddled battle to the death. What begins as a shocking revelation ignites a fierce rivalry fueled by power, ambition, and betrayal.
Lords of War is produced by Philippe Rousselet, Fabrice Gianfermi, Andrew Niccol, and Nicolas Cage.
Lords of War, written and directed by Andrew Niccol, opens in US theaters on January 22, 2027.

videos.title: SCSKiller - The Beginning Of The End For PC #StutterStruggle?
videos.summary: Many thanks to Alienware for sponsoring this video. To learn more about Alienware’s 39-inch 5K OLED Gaming Monitor, check it out here:
body: It's been years now since Digital Foundry began its campaign against intrusive stuttering in PC games and while there has been fundamental change in PC gaming, it's still an issue in many new titles. Meanwhile, a massive back catalogue of releases may never receive official updates to resolve the issue. Enter SCSKiller - an app inspired by Alex's anti-stutter campaign, put together by DF Supporter BlueHeisenberg - that aims to take an external, brute force approach to the issue. It's not perfect, but it is capable of some astonishing results.
